lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, may sell up to ₹9.13 crore via 67,500 shares in the offer for sale.
Their shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, a recent trigger for this call.
Family link: shares the surname Dixit with Amit Arun Dixit, and Ashwini's middle name Amit is that person's first name.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹64.08 crore at offer price; the average cost of acquisition is unknown.
